rule.description: Send urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:Group:DirXML-ADAliasName to AD when a Group is being created
rule.comment: Since urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:ilm:static:1.0:Group:DirXML-ADAliasName is mapped to sAMAccountName in the smp policy, this will populate the pre-windows 2000 logon name in AD with the object name in eDirectory. Since Windows 2000 is no longer supported by Microsoft, this policy won' t trim the value to 20 characters like it was required to work with that OS.
